test_title: Delhi Police Constable (Executive) 2023 - GK/CA (Held on: 15 Nov, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: gk
question: Turmeric powder is adulterated with:
solution:
The correct answer is __**lead chromate**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• Lead chromate is a bright yellow chemical compound and is used as an adulterant to enhance the color of turmeric powder.
 
• It is highly toxic and can cause various health issues such as abdominal pain, vomiting, and even cancer if consumed regularly.
 
• The presence of lead chromate in turmeric is a serious health concern and is strictly prohibited in food products.
 
• Consumption of contaminated turmeric powder can lead to heavy metal poisoning, which can severely affect the kidneys, brain, and other vital organs.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Lead Chromate**

 
 
• Lead chromate (PbCrO4) is a chemical compound that appears as a yellow powder and is commonly used as a pigment in paints and dyes.
 
• Due to its bright yellow color, it is sometimes used to adulterate turmeric powder to make it appear more vibrant and appealing.
 
• However, lead is a highly toxic metal, and its consumption can lead to severe health issues.
 
 
 
• **Zinc Carbonate**
 
 
• Zinc carbonate (ZnCO3) is a white crystalline powder used in various industrial applications, including cosmetics and pharmaceuticals.
 
• While it is not typically used to adulterate turmeric, it is important to note that zinc carbonate itself is not toxic if used within permissible limits.
 
 
 
• **Silicon Oxide**
 
 
• Silicon oxide (SiO2), also known as silica, is a naturally occurring mineral found in sand and quartz.
 
• It is used in the food industry as an anti-caking agent but is not known to be used as an adulterant in turmeric powder.
 
 
 
• **Magnesium Chloride**
 
 
• Magnesium chloride (MgCl2) is a chemical compound used in various industrial and pharmaceutical applications.
 
• It is not typically associated with the adulteration of turmeric powder.
